Brackenridge Health
Mrs Margaret Hughes
Hospital number: BH-482917
Date: 5 October 2026
Your procedure: appointment and preparation
Dear Mrs Margaret Hughes,
You are booked for a cataract surgery (right eye). The cloudy lens in your right eye is removed and replaced with
a clear artificial lens. This letter tells you when and where to come, how to prepare, and what to expect afterwards.
Please read it carefully and keep it.
Your appointment
Date Thursday 12 November 2026
Please arrive at 08:30

Where Eye Day Unit, Level 1, Brackenridge Community Hospital
Anaesthetic Local anaesthetic (you will be awake; the area is numbed)
Type of stay Day case: expect to be with us for about 3 hours
Eating and drinking
You can eat and drink normally before your operation.
Your medicines
(cid:127) Keep taking your usual medicines, including eye drops, unless told otherwise.
(cid:127) If you take blood-thinning medicines, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.
What to bring

(cid:127) A list of your medicines
(cid:127) Your glasses
(cid:127) Something to read
Please leave jewellery and valuables at home.
Going home
You will need someone to take you home, as you will not be able to drive. Do not drive until your eye doctor says
your sight meets the legal standard.
Most people notice clearer sight within a few days. Use your eye drops as shown for 4 weeks.
When to get help
Contact us straight away if you have any of the following:
(cid:127) Increasing pain in the eye

(cid:127) Your sight gets worse
(cid:127) Increasing redness or sticky discharge
